product_overview: Athletia is a REST API for athlete tracking focused on sleep logs, injuries, and gym search. This PRD covers the testable backend flows for authenticated CRUD operations and external gym lookup handling.
core_goals: Validate JWT-based authentication as prerequisite for protected endpoints
Support CRUD operations for sleep logs and injuries owned by the authenticated user
Enforce field-level validation rules and ownership checks on protected resources
Verify controlled error handling for missing, invalid, or unauthorized requests
Confirm gym search endpoints validate input and handle external provider failures gracefully

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Register a user and log in to obtain a JWT token used for protected API requests.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/register with valid unique email and strong matching passwords -> Receive 201 with created user -> POST /api/v1/auth/login with the same credentials -> Receive 200 with user data and JWT token
POST /api/v1/auth/register with weak password or mismatched confirmPassword -> Receive 400 validation error
POST /api/v1/auth/login with invalid email or password -> Receive 401 credentials invalid

features.name: Sleep Logs (RF-12 editar, RF-13 eliminar)
features.description: Create, view, update, and delete sleep logs owned by the authenticated user.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/v1/sleeps with valid sleep data and Bearer token -> Receive 201 with created sleep log -> GET /api/v1/sleeps/{id} with token -> Receive 200 with the stored sleep log
POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> PUT /api/v1/sleeps/{id} with empty body {} and token -> Receive 400 validation error or empty body
POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> PUT /api/v1/sleeps/{id} with invalid values such as sleepQuality 11 or hoursSlept 30 -> Receive 400 validation error
POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> PUT /api/v1/sleeps/{id} for a non-existent sleep id -> Receive 404 not found

POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> DELETE /api/v1/sleeps/{id} with token -> Receive 204 no content -> GET /api/v1/sleeps/{id} with token -> Receive 404 not found
GET /api/v1/sleeps/{id} without Authorization header -> Receive 401 unauthorized

features.name: Injuries (RF-14 reportar, RF-15 editar, RF-16 eliminar)
features.description: Report, view, update, and delete injury records owned by the authenticated user.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/v1/injuries with valid bodyArea, injuryName, severity, and token -> Receive 201 with created injury -> GET /api/v1/injuries/{id} with token -> Receive 200 with the stored injury
POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/v1/injuries with bodyArea containing numbers or injuryName containing symbols -> Receive 400 validation error
POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> PUT /api/v1/injuries/{id} with empty body {} -> Receive 400 validation error or empty body
POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> PUT /api/v1/injuries/{id} with invalid severity outside 1-10 -> Receive 400 validation error
POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> PUT /api/v1/injuries/{id} for a non-existent injury id -> Receive 404 not found

POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> DELETE /api/v1/injuries/{id} with token -> Receive 204 no content -> GET /api/v1/injuries/{id} with token -> Receive 404 not found
GET /api/v1/injuries/{id} without Authorization header -> Receive 401 unauthorized

features.name: Gym Finder (RF-18 buscar gimnasios)
features.description: Search for gyms using Google Places through authenticated endpoints, with validation and controlled external-service error handling.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/v1/gyms/search?q=fitness with token -> Receive 502 external service error handled as JSON because Google Places billing is inactive

POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/v1/gyms/nearby?lat=40.4168&lng=-3.7038 with token -> Receive 502 external service error handled as JSON because Google Places billing is inactive
POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/v1/gyms/search with missing q -> Receive 400 validation error
POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/v1/gyms/nearby?lat=40.4168&lng=-3.7038&radius=60000 -> Receive 400 validation error
GET /api/v1/gyms/search?q=fitness without Authorization header -> Receive 401 unauthorized

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Registro e inicio de sesión con JWT. Solo se usa como preparación para obtener un token; no es objetivo de prueba.

endpoints.description: Registra un usuario (password de 12+ caracteres con mayúscula, minúscula, número y símbolo; confirmPassword igual)
Inicia sesión y devuelve un token JWT (no requiere verificar el correo)

features.name: Sleep Logs (RF-12 editar, RF-13 eliminar)
features.description: CRUD de registros de sueño del usuario autenticado. Los registros de otro usuario no se encuentran (404).

endpoints.description: Crea un registro de sueño (preparación para RF-12 y RF-13)
Obtiene un registro de sueño por id
RF-12, edita un registro de sueño; requiere al menos un campo

response_schema.404: No existe o pertenece a otro usuario

endpoints.description: RF-13, elimina un registro de sueño

response_schema.404: No existe o pertenece a otro usuario

features.name: Injuries (RF-14 reportar, RF-15 editar, RF-16 eliminar)
features.description: CRUD de lesiones del usuario autenticado. bodyArea e injuryName solo aceptan letras y espacios.

endpoints.description: RF-15, edita una lesión; requiere al menos un campo

response_schema.404: No existe o pertenece a otro usuario
No existe o pertenece a otro usuario

features.name: Gym Finder (RF-18 buscar gimnasios)
features.description: Búsqueda de gimnasios mediante Google Places. En este entorno Google no tiene facturación activa, así que con parámetros válidos se espera 502 EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR controlado.

endpoints.description: Busca gimnasios por texto (q obligatorio; lat y lng opcionales)

known_limitations.issue: Google Places sin facturación activa; las búsquedas válidas devuelven 502 en lugar de resultados
known_limitations.impact: RF-18 solo puede verificar validación, autenticación y manejo del error externo
